subject.title: refactor(ui): consolidate model configuration onto the Models page

question: Should the existing Models route become the sole Control UI surface for global model defaults and behavior, with General serving only as a navigation hub and Agent Defaults no longer exposing the raw provider-model section?
rationale: The implementation reuses existing configuration paths and has real UI proof, but the choice to remove familiar settings locations is a product-information-architecture decision rather than a mechanically provable bug fix.

options.title: Approve the consolidated Models owner
options.body: Land the refactor with Models as the single destination, retaining the supplied Agent Defaults redirect and current save semantics.

options.title: Retain a secondary entry point
options.body: Keep a discoverable General or Agent Defaults shortcut if maintainers want the previous settings taxonomy to remain directly accessible.

recommendation.title: Approve the consolidated Models owner
recommendation.body: Land the refactor with Models as the single destination, retaining the supplied Agent Defaults redirect and current save semantics.

likelyOwner.reason: The supplied commits show steipete driving this specific settings-consolidation direction.
